defense_dimensions.description: 所有权已转移至外部容器、智能指针或上游调用方托管
依赖类析构函数或作用域守卫执行物理资源释放，无实质泄漏
属于进程生命周期短程工具或静态全局单例，进程退出自动由 OS 清理

description: 专项检测代码中的内存泄漏风险，包括未关闭资源、循环引用等
name: memory_leak

categories.label: 基础内存泄漏
categories.definition: Owned heap allocation loses its final reachable owner before deletion.
decision_rules: success or failure path drops pointer
positive_hints: all paths free or transfer memory

categories.label: 资源泄漏
categories.definition: A file, socket, lock, handle, or other resource can remain open after use.
decision_rules: close is missing or not exception-safe
positive_hints: RAII or explicit close covers paths

categories.label: 野指针与悬空指针
categories.definition: A pointer or reference can outlive the object it names.
decision_rules: no renewal or guard prevents use

categories.label: 重复释放
categories.definition: The same owned allocation can be released twice.
decision_rules: two release paths reach one owner
ownership is copied rather than transferred

categories.label: 异常安全
categories.definition: A throwing or early-return path skips required cleanup.
decision_rules: operation can throw or return early
invariant or resource state is broken
positive_hints: defer, RAII, or try/catch cleans up

categories.label: 智能指针问题
categories.definition: Smart-pointer ownership, aliasing, or reset policy is incorrect.
decision_rules: shared and unique ownership are mixed
cyclic or premature release is possible
negative_hints: raw pointer is a non-owning view

categories.label: RAII原则违反
categories.definition: A deterministic cleanup object is missing or does not own its resource.
decision_rules: manual acquisition and release are separated
RAII wrapper is absent or wrong

categories.label: 其他常见问题
categories.definition: A credible memory or lifecycle risk that does not fit a specific controlled category.
